title: A scam victim who takes out cash and feeds a crypto cash machine
summary: A victim takes out cash at a counter in several sums. Each sum is fed into a crypto cash machine, which sends bitcoin to the scammer's wallet.

basis.note: The report says that criminals coach or coerce victims to feed machines and spread small payments over many machines. The sizes and counts are assumed. A case uses one machine, which differs from the report's spread over many machines.

steps.say: The victim takes out cash at a counter, 2 to 8 times.

basis.note: No source read for the library describes a victim withdrawing cash at a counter. The report describes victims who are coached to feed crypto cash machines. The sums of 300 to 2,500 pounds, the counts and the waits of 6 to 30 hours are assumed. The victim is drawn from the quarter of older customers who hold the most, which is also assumed.

steps.say: The victim feeds each sum of cash into the crypto cash machine.

basis.note: The report describes victims who feed machines. The wait is assumed.

steps.say: The machine sends the value in bitcoin to the scammer's wallet.

basis.note: The report describes the machine as the way to the scammer's wallet. The wait is assumed, and the machine's own fee is not modelled.
